segments.sn45.40:1.5: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi … pe … sammāsamādhi.
segments.sn45.40:1.9: Yo kho, bhikkhave, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, brahmacariyattho”ti.
segments.sn45.40:2.3: Sāmaññena ca dve vuttā, brahmaññā apare duve;
segments.sn45.40:2.5: Brahmacariyena dve vuttā, vaggo tena pavuccatīti.
